The district court is allowed to consider departing from the guidelines to sentence a defendant as if the career offender provision applied.

The use of consecutive sentences constitutes a departure from the sentencing guidelines.

Osuji testified in his own defense with the assistance of his counsel.
The habeas petition was dismissed based on a mandatory and unwaivable state procedural rule.
